question: Let the drafters skip permissions?
context: Synthetic Let the drafters skip permissions?

run.description: Change some settings of a group and keep the rest
does: changes the group drafters on the herdr runner: what each of its sessions runs, as the lines below say, and nothing else of it.
It starts claude (Claude Code) agents with no flags of their own now.
It will start them with "--dangerously-skip-permissions": the bypass preset, never asks; runs as you with full access.
It skips permissions: it runs without asking for permission.

weight.line: brings a program the yard will run: its permission flags of the group drafters, which each session the yard starts for it then runs as the card shows
